name: Track Analysis
author: pedro
summary: Generate missing phrases and vocal intervals for USB and Beatport tracks.
description: Reads existing PVDI vocal detection first. Generates missing vocal intervals and PVDI in a background process, independently of phrase availability. When phrases are also missing, analyzes them against the loaded native beat grid and publishes them immediately. Preserves populated grids, phrases, PVDI, cues and waveforms. Vocal fallback uses a spectral heuristic, not source separation. Requires the v2 track-analysis SDK services, qualified on firmware 2.00 for USB OneLibrary and completed Beatport downloads. Folder-only tracks, encrypted media and HE-AAC are unsupported.
